In NH caught using flight intercept traps at a protected kettle bog, old-growth mixed deciduous / coniferous forest, an old-growth silver maple floodplain forest, and at the margin of a freshwater marsh. Also taken by sifting, and in red and chestnut oak litter. Elsewhere captured by Lindgren funnel traps in an old-growth eastern white cedar forest and a rich Appalachian hardwood forest with some conifers; one specimen was taken from decaying moldy corncobs and cornhusks near a mixed forest (Webster et al. 2016).
